title: Chapter 679
text:
Gureja and the others got the answer they wanted and were overjoyed. After finalizing the details, they left with satisfaction.

The few of them walked out of the Black Star Corps base. Looking back at the majestic base, Gureja suddenly felt a little emotional.

"Black Star has only been a mercenary for less than ten years, yet he has already developed to what he is today. He's really an unbelievable guy."

"Everyone who has the potential to become a Beyond Grade A has their own legends. It's not something we can speculate about." Another person shook his head and sighed.

"That's right. He's no longer on the same level as us. Luckily, we knew him long ago."

Gureja had mixed feelings.

…

In a certain corridor of the Black Star Corps headquarters, Herlous and the three Volga brothers walked side by side and chatted casually.

"Have you heard? Three Calamity Grade Supers have joined. His Excellency Black Star personally met them. They will definitely take up important positions in the army in the future," the eldest Volga brother suddenly said.

"I know." Herlous nodded. He was both happy and frustrated.

He was happy about the rapid development of the Black Star Corps, but he was frustrated that his position would be affected because of this.

With three Calamity Grade Supers joining the upper echelons of the army, the competition would become even more intense. Herlous felt a lot of pressure.

Strength represented the right to speak. He had not been able to touch the threshold of Grade A for a long time, so his importance to the army would become lower and lower. There were already many mid-level combatants. If not for the fact that he was the first to follow Black Star, he would not have the right to become an upper echelon of the army with his Grade B strength.

Herlous felt that his growth was already quite fast, but he still could not keep up with Han Xiao's footsteps. He also could not keep up with the rapid development of the Black Star Corps. He did not want to fall behind just like that, so he became more and more anxious.

In order to train his physique, he had even reduced the time he spent playing cards from three hours a day to one and a half hours a day. It was impossible for him not to play cards, not in this lifetime.

"Calamity Grade … it's really far away."

Herlous sighed.

…

The development of the Black Star Corps made the old officers sigh with emotion. However, as the saying went, the wheel of history rolled forward, and everything was in a state of development. Naturally, Han Xiao would not stand still.

It took Han Xiao seven to eight days to meet all the emissaries from various organizations who came to seek cooperation. He reorganized the structure of the Black Star Corps after its scale had skyrocketed. Only then did he have some free time.

Han Xiao locked himself in his office and took out a piece of paper to summarize all the benefits of this expansion and the new development blueprint.

The rapid development of the Black Star Corps had exceeded his expectations. His original plan of seeking stability was already outdated. A large number of organizations and Star System civilizations had taken the initiative to provide him with all sorts of development opportunities. It would be a waste not to use them. As long as he could make good use of these opportunities, the Black Star Corps' development speed would increase by tens to hundreds of times!

This was an unprecedented harvest of leeks!

Han Xiao wrote and drew on the paper, listing out the maximum benefits that the various opportunities could bring in theory, as well as the costs that needed to be invested. He made a simple list to make it easier to judge.

At the same time, he also used the equipment quality system to analyze the faction and divided it into two attributes. One was the current scale, and the other was the development potential.

The current scale was determined by the resources, scale, armed forces, number of members, influence, and so on.

The development potential was determined by the connections, allies, business scope, long-term profits, development opportunities, and so on.

Han Xiao first took out a reference object to evaluate the Black Star Corps. He evaluated the Bloodshed Land as [Orange] Current Scale and [Orange] Development Potential. With that as the basis, he began to analyze the Black Star Corps.

"Not counting the players, before this large-scale expansion, the Black Star Corps' business was limited to a few Star Systems, and its scale was between [Dark Green] and [Light Blue]. Now, it should be [Light Purple]. After Philip recruits the second and third batches of people, it should be able to stabilize at [Purple] grade. "

Han Xiao pondered as he spun the pen in his hand.

"In terms of development potential, my reputation as a Beyond Grade A seed belongs to [Orange] grade. The secret war is the channel to build a bridge with the Amethyst Civilization, which is also [Orange] grade. The contracts with the various Star System civilizations are [Orange] grade. Leading the establishment of the Mercenary Alliance is [Pink] grade. Together with my connections, potential, and other factors … on average, the total development potential of the faction is [Orange] grade."

Han Xiao looked at the list on the paper and nodded.

This would allow him to understand the development of the Black Star Corps more directly. As long as he could fulfill the [Orange] development potential, he would be able to quickly pass the [Purple] grade and enter the [Pink] grade.

Once his scale reached [Pink], he would be a famous Star Field level organization. Although it was still a distance away from the Bloodshed Land, it would be a true super-large organization.

Han Xiao began to plan the development of the various opportunities.

"The Star System civilizations invited me to build a sub-base. This is a way to expand my territory. The manpower I recruited can be put to good use immediately. I can send them to new Star Systems and expand the scope of my business … Hmm, I can also send some of them to develop resource planets. This will solve the problem of the organization's transformation. Other than employment and war, there will also be more resource gathering businesses. The sources of profit will be more diverse …

Hmm, if I don't have enough manpower, I can also pull in the Blue Star people to make up the numbers and let some of them become galactic residents first. Furthermore, mining seems to be the strength of those bugs. With my reputation in the Black Spirit Race, I should be able to find a large amount of high-quality labor. "

Han Xiao made a tick behind 'Star System Civilization'.

"Leading the establishment of the Shattered Star Ring Mercenary Alliance is also very simple. My large-scale expansion will increase my influence, and it will be a hot topic in the Shattered Star Ring. With the support of the other large armies, as long as I raise my arm, it won't be a problem to gather the members of the alliance. The next step is just a matter of time …"

Han Xiao came up with plans one by one and very quickly created the prototype of the new development blueprint.

He put down the pen, picked up the paper, and shook it. A satisfied smile appeared on his face.

Han Xiao memorized the contents of the paper. Then, with a pinch of his finger, the paper turned into dust.

"When Version 3.0 is released, the changes in the Black Star Corps will probably shock the players."

…

With this development momentum, the Black Star Corps became very active. They recruited many times, and the number of members gradually approached ten million. Most of them were sent out by Han Xiao to build sub-bases in the various Star Systems of the Colton Star Cluster. The area of activity of the army expanded from the Garton Star System to more than half of the Star Cluster.

Han Xiao did not neglect the secret war. After dealing with the matters of the expansion, he returned to the battlefield and continued to fight with Bloodshed Land.

As the leader, he fought for the Amethyst Civilization on the frontlines, and the large number of new members behind him were managing the business and increasing their forces. The sudden increase in manpower was enough to support such a two-front operation and contribute to the development of the Black Star Corps.

As the momentum of the expansion passed, the storm of public opinion caused by the Beyond Grade A seed gradually cooled down. Han Xiao had become the biggest beneficiary. The Black Star Corps left a deep impression in the entire Star Field through this wave of operations, and their reputation had already squeezed into the category of famous Star Field organizations.

Under such circumstances, the Black Star Corps was still the Field Team of Floating Dragon in name. Floating Dragon maintained its silence, but under the influence of some people, more and more people began to see the Black Star Corps and Floating Dragon as two independent organizations. The public opinion also began to show signs of separating the two sides.

The storm stirred up by Han Xiao had a far-reaching impact. More organizations participated in the secret war openly and in the dark, causing the scope of this war to become larger and larger.

The secret war was originally one of the main storyline missions of Version 3.0 [Crimson Tide], but its limelight was gradually overshadowed. More organizations gradually turned their attention to Han Xiao and the Black Star Corps.

The war continued, and the Black Star Corps continued to develop. The visible and invisible influences continued to ferment, and the situation gradually changed.

The Blue Star Corps changed seasons three times.
